static_traits.name: Li Lian
static_traits.social_status: Overall Good relationship with boyfriend; usually talks with friends when encountering difficulties, but has not yet shared insecurity and Anxiety with friends this time
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; has not yet received counseling or psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, able to self-Reflect; subjectively feeling tense but hopeful

basic_info.main_problem: I have always felt Anxiety and insecurity about the dance class I attend with my boyfriend; I have an irrational belief that because the dance class is not going smoothly, he will leave me.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking support because relationship insecurity and Anxiety in the dance class with my boyfriend are worsening, hoping to ease these problems and gain more balanced views and coping approaches.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/not good enough
If the relationship goes badly, I will be abandoned

special_situations.event: Making step mistakes and poor coordination in the dance class with boyfriend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If we are not doing well in dance, it shows our relationship has problems
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly overthinking and rehearsing the worst case before and after class, trying to obtain a sense of control through worrying in advance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will leave me because we do not dance well

special_situations.event: Worrying about failing and being judged in front of boyfriend and the coach
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in front of him and the coach, he will think I am not competent enough, and the relationship is a mistake
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly Self-monitoring during class, trying to avoid mistakes to prevent being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must think this relationship is a mistake

special_situations.event: Before each dance class, thinks of previous mistakes and infers overall performance from them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One or a few poor performances mean we will always fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on mistakes to 'remind' themselves to improve, ignoring neutral or positive information

special_situations.event: Ignoring boyfriend's encouragement and positive feedback during class, focusing on mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback does not represent the real situation; mistakes are what show the problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negating positive signals, using self-reproach to drive improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: His encouragement is just consolation; I am actually incapable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be steadily accepted and affirmed in intimate relationships and to be securely attached
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and rejected for failure, ultimately being abandoned and falling into isolation
defense_goal: Avoiding being hurt and negated through Anticipating the worst in advance, mind reading, and excessive Self-monitoring

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is not competent enough, prone to mistakes, needing recognition
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who is supportive on the surface but imagined as a potential judge / rejecter

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When making mistakes in dance class or feeling noticed and judged by boyfriend/coach
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting one's own insecurity as the other's negative view: believing the other sees the relationship as a mistake and may leave (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing worry in an uncertain and tense tone, frequently using speculative phrasings like 'will he...', seeking reassurance and comfort.

manifestations: Strongly fears being abandoned, equating mistakes in dance class with relationship failure
Highly caring about and speculating how others (boyfriend) see oneself
outcomes: Anticipating the worst outcome before and after each dance class, overall mood affected, relationship pressured

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Highly Self-monitoring during class, fearing mistakes
Excessively worrying about being judged by partner and coach
Rehearsing the worst outcome in a catastrophic way

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing boyfriend sees the relationship as a mistake and will leave (mind reading)
Interpreting one's own insecurity as the other's negative view

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Although having a friend support network, has not shared Anxiety and insecurity with friends this time
Bears stress inwardly, copes through self-blame

positive_force: The partner continuously encourages and supports during the course (persisting in attending class, praising small progress)
Can notice and name cognitive patterns, willing to try a more balanced perspective
Actively seeks counseling, positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments
Has a friend support network (although not yet sought help on this issue)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, overgeneralization, and mental filtering
Highly sensitive to failure, directly equating poor performance with declining relationship quality
Excessive Self-monitoring and self-reproach, over-caring about others' evaluations
Fear of Loneliness and abandonment reinforcing a maladaptive Interpretation cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and insecurity when attending dance class with boyfriend
antecedent: When attending dance class with boyfriend
Making step mistakes or poor coordination
Under the gaze and evaluation of the coach or partner
target_behavior.core_reason: The cognitive bias of directly equating dance performance with relationship quality (catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization), accompanied by Fear of being judged and abandoned
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions and seeking security; trying to gain control and assurance through Anticipating the worst in advance
target_behavior.consequence: Significant anxiety before and after each class, overall mood and Decreased enjoyment of life, the relationship under extra pressure
